details: Canonicalizing Arabic spelling variation before processing: hamza forms (أ إ آ ا), ta marbuta vs. ha (ة / ه), alef maqsura vs. ya (ى / ي), removing tatweel (ـــ) and optional diacritics. Small preprocessing decisions here move retrieval and matching metrics more than model choice sometimes does; the normalization scheme must be identical at indexing and query time.
